summary: Avricore Health Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing several exhibits: a notice of annual general meeting (AGM) set for June 18, 2026, with record dates, a management information circular, proxy materials, and a news release announcing a $1.25 million financing. No specific terms (price per share, premium) are provided for the financing; it appears to be a routine capital raise combined with standard AGM documentation. No board recommendation or advisor is named for the financing. The filing is entirely procedural: an AGM notice and a general financing announcement, not a transformative or negotiated special situation. What to watch: whether the financing terms are disclosed in subsequent filings; otherwise, no risk-arb angle applies.
